messages.en:
{07 00 00}Hey, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00} Can I ask
you a favor?{01 00 00 05 00} It's a big
one, but it's pretty easy.
I need you to deliver a
present to {ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00},
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00} Can ya do it?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Hei, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00} Kas ma võin
paluda teenet?{01 00 00 05 00} See on suur,
aga üsna lihtne.
Ma vajan, et sa viiksid
kingituse {ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00} juurde,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00} Kas sa saad?

messages.en:
{07 00 00}{07 14 00}Oh, hey. Look, I'm sorry to
bug you like this, but I
need a favor.
Could you take this present
over to {ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00} {ff 00 00 00}for
me, {04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}{07 14 00}Oh, hei. Vaata, vabandust,
et ma sind nii tülitan, aga
ma vajan teenet.
Kas sa viiksid selle kingi
{ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00} {ff 00 00 00}juurde minu
eest, {04 02 00}?
